product.name: MindQuest Logic Challenge
product.description: MindQuest Logic Challenge is a family‑friendly board game that blends strategy, pattern recognition, and critical thinking. Players compete to assemble a series of geometric tiles on a modular board, using limited moves to create continuous shapes. The game includes a rulebook, a set of 120 tiles, a timer, and a score sheet, all packaged in a sturdy cardboard box. Designed for ages 8 and up, it encourages cooperative play while challenging individual problem‑solving skills. The colorful components and compact size make it suitable for travel or home use, and the game’s modular layout allows for endless variations in each session.
